title: feat(nm2rdholfz): neighbor-read of cyclic-frame holonomy at t+1 on three-axis far-face opposite unit square: reverse fails, face fails
science: Holonomy template: four unit squares, edge P(q,r)=F(q)^T F(r), holonomy = P12 P23 P34 P41. A-square product is printed as the identity; B/C/D fail only because a corner has split fail, and an entirely out-of-host square at z=4 returns fail too. Recompute: the four-edge product telescopes to F1^T F1 = I over all 331,776 corner-frame assignments, so 'product == I_3' is an algebraic identity, never a measurement.
